output.name: rtk
output.purpose: Filter real command output while preserving exit status, permissions and an unfiltered evidence route.

criteria.description: Verify the actual Rust Token Killer executable and supported native wrapper.
Preserve command meaning, exit status, permissions and provider choice.
Keep an unfiltered route for exact evidence and distinguish output ratios from billing.

limits: Mechanical verification checks recorded facts and actual retained bytes; a recorded semantic inspection is not authenticated judgment.
Compilation and fixture success do not prove complete semantic workflow performance or provider/native-host activation.
Actual provider/runtime access is required for execution. Verification does not start a provider job, proxy or account session.
The deterministic core does not filter a command or measure token savings. Exercise actual RTK with preserved exits, native permissions and unfiltered evidence.
